posts.title: The log starts here
posts.html:
This is where I write down what I am working on and what I run into. Not polished write-ups — the projects page already does that. This is the running account: the thing that broke, the measurement that surprised me, the decision I made and why.

I am starting it because I keep solving the same problem twice. Something goes wrong at two in the morning, I fix it, and four months later I hit the same wall with no memory of what the answer was. Writing it down is cheaper than rediscovering it.

Delete this post once there is a real one under it.
